mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, unusually greater standardized absolute displacement per unit BTC base volume on Upbit than on Binance perpetual identifies Korean cash as the marginal price-discovery venue. At a fresh dominance-tail onset, follow the completed Upbit direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed eight-hour KRW-BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: Korean cash lead-lag uses return timing, Korean variance leadership uses variation, kimchi candidates use cross-currency price premium, and participation candidates compare volume shares. HVKID compares venue-normalized Amihud-style absolute path displacement per common BTC base-volume unit after separate causal standardization. It reuses no event set or control and uses no spot execution count, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed Binance variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and cross-venue impact dominance its causal upper quintile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 04:05/12:05/20:05 UTC Korean impact-dominance onsets are absent from Gross9 clocks

features.aligned_block: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute aggregates from 480 unique coherent one-minute rows per venue in [D-8h,D)
features.venues: bars_upbit KRW-BTC and bars_binance BTCUSDT perpetual
features.five_minute_return: log(last constituent close/first constituent open), separately by venue
features.base_volume: sum nonnegative BTC base volume over all 480 one-minute rows, separately by venue; strict positive
features.impact_coordinate: log(sum over 96 abs(five-minute return)/sum BTC base volume), separately by venue; numerator strict positive
features.impact_zscore: each venue coordinate minus mean divided by sample std of at most 270 strictly prior jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; sample std strict positive
features.korean_impact_dominance: Upbit impact zscore minus Binance impact zscore; strict positive
features.dominance_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(korean_impact_dominance) over at most 270 jointly valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.binance_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared Binance five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.upbit_block_return: log(last Upbit close/first Upbit open), finite strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled jointly source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-venue price-impact dominance mechanism selected from schema and formula-absence audit only

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no venue, aggregation, volume unit, impact coordinate, standardization, dominance sign, history, rank, threshold, variation, onset, clock, hold, side, subset, source, or control repair
